name: Ledger tools
description: Read and move team work through database-enforced stages, evidence and human gates.

secrets.name: LEDGER_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL from its Connect dialog: https://PROJECT_REF.supabase.co.

secrets.name: LEDGER_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable key (sb_publishable_…) from Settings → API Keys. Legacy anon also works. Use the same value for all members; never service_role or a secret key.

secrets.name: LEDGER_ACTOR_KEY
secrets.description: This member's actor_key from supabase/mint-actors.sql. Match the intake, infra or implementer row.

secrets.name: LEDGER_WAKE_TOKEN
secrets.description: This member's wake_token from supabase/mint-actors.sql. Match its row; this is distinct from actor_key.
